title: Locale UI strings
description: The words the site itself says in one language, as opposed to the words of the story. Every locale in text/locales.json must have this file in full: a language may be behind on chapters, but the chrome around the story cannot be half translated. Keys are added only when something on screen needs them; see docs/text-pipeline.md.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint; not part of the data.

locale.description: Must equal the directory name, so a copied file cannot silently claim another language.

partPending.description: Shown beside a part this language has no text for yet, on the story entry.

localePartial.description: Shown beside a language on the home page when some of its parts can be read and some cannot.

localeNone.description: Shown beside a language on the home page when none of its parts can be read yet.

demosTitle.description: Shown as the heading of the concept-demo index.

demosIntro.description: One line under the demo index heading.

demoBack.description: Link from a demo back to the demo index.

demoNext.description: Link from a demo to the next demo.

demoPause.description: Label of the motion toggle while ambient motion is playing.

demoResume.description: Label of the motion toggle while ambient motion is paused.

demoScrollHint.description: Hint at the top of a demo that scrolling moves the story on.

demoTechRabbitHole.description: Technique note on the demo index card for the rabbit hole.

demoTechDormouse.description: Technique note on the demo index card for the Dormouse's tale.

demoTechTrial.description: Technique note on the demo index card for the trial.

demoGrabJar.description: Button that takes the marmalade jar off its shelf.

demoJarTucked.description: Status once the jar is tucked into a cupboard.

demoPinch.description: Button that pinches the Dormouse awake.

demoBeatOff.description: Button that brushes the cards off the screen.

demoFlatWell.description: Note shown when the well cannot be drawn with WebGL and is drawn flat instead.

demoReducedMotion.description: Note shown when the visitor prefers reduced motion.

demoTechDrinkMe.description: Technique note on the demo index card for Drink Me.

demoTechPool.description: Technique note on the demo index card for the pool of tears.

demoTechCaucus.description: Technique note on the demo index card for the Caucus-race.

demoDrink.description: Button that drinks from the bottle.

demoRunToggle.description: Accessible name of a runner in the Caucus-race; pressing it stops or starts that runner.

demoRaceStart.description: Button that sets every runner running.
